answer: Steel plates hang on the armourer’s wall, and the anvil stands polished by long use. Proof of armourer via breastplate tally — a breastplate the armourer hammers only after 43 breastplates fit true without one gaping at the seam, each hammered by the armourer himself. sparrow cuts the plate to the pattern and dishes it over the stake. spiral hammers the curve smooth and rivets the straps on. sonnet fits the breastplate on the stand and checks the seams by hand. Forty-three breastplates must fit true without one gaping at the seam, and the next still gapes where the plate ran thin.
